content.title: 11 Fresh Costco Finds Everyone Is Adding to Their Carts This March
content.text: The thing about Costco is that it’s a delight to shop at the warehouse. There’s an element of routine—stocking up on the essentials and basics—and another dash of spontaneity in finding everything from pantry treats to diamond rings, electronics, special beverages, and so much more. Popular Costco items tend to go viral and sell out (which can ruin an element of surprise), but if you strategize to search for Costco’s new and seasonal items, you may just luck out in finding some special, worthwhile purchases. Here are the brand new (and newly returned) items that Costco shoppers can buy from Costco in March 2026. Cuisinart Espresso Bar Fully Automatic Espresso Machine Credit: Costco You don’t need to be a barista to use this countertop espresso machine, which has a built-in grinder and one-touch settings to brew your favorite cup of espresso. A cold extraction setting is also available for iced drinks. Obviously, you can stock up on coffee beans and your milks of preference at Costco too. Alder & Oak EZ- Pick Apple Tree Credit: Costco This is a fun one! Costco’s garden center is known for great potted plants and gardening necessities, but add a bit of whimsy to your yard this season. This $65 potted apple tree is ready to plant and available in Fuji apple and honeycrisp varieties. You can watch it grow for years, and have freshly picked apples seasonally. Sea Cuisine Guinness Battered Fish Strips Credit: Sea Cuisine New to the freezer aisle this spring, an easy-to-make rendition of beer-battered fish and chips—just grab a bag of fries or tots to pair with these crispy fish filets and cook ‘em in the air fryer. Developed to mimic the pub classic, these crisp seafood bites are available with Alaska pollock or tail-off shrimp. So far, shoppers approve. “Just tried them today for lunch. The batter had a good crunch,” one Reddit user declared1. Shine Muscat Grapes Credit: Costco If you’re in the market for luxury fruit, Costco has it! These oversized, seedless grapes are aesthetically pleasing in the package and on the vine. Imported from Peru, each grape is a treat more than a common fruit, and would make a great hosting gift or charcuterie board addition. Toom Garlic Dip and Spread Credit: Costco Back after much anticipation, toom has returned to Costco! The garlicky Lebanese dip is excellent straight from the tub to dunk snacks into, or used as a spread on flatbreads, sandwiches, and more. It can also add garlicky flavor to marinades, dressings, sauces, and condiments. Chef Carla Hall always grabs toom from Costco, and loves to add it to her eggs. Chosen Foods Steakhouse Caesar Dressing Credit: Chosen Foods This avocado oil brand’s new steakhouse-inspired salad dressings and marinades are now sold at Costco in packs of two bottles. The garlicky dressing is made with avocado oil and no artificial ingredients, and is great for Caesar salads at home, marinades, pasta, sandwiches, and more. “It’s so good,” one shopper shared. Strawberry and Cheese Danish A highly in-demand flavor for Costco’s bakery, they finally delivered! The strawberry and cheese danish is the treat of the season, stuffed with sweet cheese and strawberry preserves, and drizzled with a thick icing. These danishes are sold in packs of four, and are already a hit with shoppers who have dubbed them “delicious.” Related Stories Double Chocolate Mint Sundae This new seasonal food court item may not make it past the parking lot, but it’s a great dessert to round out a shopping spree at Costco. Or perhaps a reason to visit in its own right! The $2.99 sundae is made with layers of mint or mint and vanilla swirl soft serve, and topped with chocolate cookie crumbles and a drizzle of chocolate sauce. It’s the perfect chocolate mint combo, and worth grabbing ASAP. “I had one today as my treat for finishing my marathon this weekend,” one shopper shared on Instagram. “Truly amazing.” Cadbury Mini Eggs Credit: Costco If you can eat these springtime chocolates by the pound, this 42-ounce bag is for you. The milk chocolate mini eggs are various shades of pastel and enjoyable by the handful or baked into treats like cookies or as decoration on a frosted cake. Laoban Chinese Style BBQ Pork Bao Buns Credit: Costco This 12-pack of Chinese pork buns is a great Costco find when you see them in the freezer section. Stuffed with Berkshire pork, the squishy buns are ready after just a minute in the microwave, and are the perfect size for a meaty snack or appetizer. Mazala Tikka Paneer Pizza New to Costco’s freezer section, this Indian-inspired pizza is sold in two packs. It’s the perfect quick-to-make meal for a flavorful twist on pizza night. The thin crust is topped with classic tikka masala sauce, mozzarella cheese, paneer cubes, green peppers, onions, and more, which means each pizza packs 76 grams of protein.
